entries.title: Gmail and Calendar go through Google's own servers for AI agents
entries.body: Infinitary now reaches Gmail and Calendar through the servers Google makes for AI agents. Setting up your Google client now asks you to tick "Use this client for an AI-powered agent" and turn on Google's Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets services for agents. If your client still needs that mark or a service is off, the Google row says so, and Open Google Cloud opens the page that fixes it. When Google asks you to confirm a call, a card shows its question and choices. Calendar automations now check every 5 minutes. Removing Google also deletes what your first mate and crew read from it.

picture.alt: The Google row in Settings → Integrations saying Mark your client for agents, with an Open Google Cloud button
